Wind and deep passing: high wind cuts air yards and deep completions, hitting deep-threat receivers and QB yardage more than underneath roles.

combo.mechanism: Combo and parlay markets multiply legs whose outcomes are correlated through game script, team strength and shared stat sources; a fair price requires the joint probability, not the product. Contract wording per leg (void/push handling, overtime) and fees affect value, and executable liquidity is thinner.
combo.target: Joint probability that all (or specified) legs resolve as required, under each leg's wording and the combo's own voiding rules.

inputs.why: Correlation structure between legs determines joint probability.
Team strength underlies winner/margin legs.
Team total consistency across legs.
Script links spreads, totals and player props.
Key-number lattice for margin legs.
Marginal distribution for player legs.
Combo price versus correlated product.
Per-leg void and push handling.
Fees scale with price and apply to the combo as a whole, so a thin correlation edge can be consumed by fee plus spread on the combined contract.
Combo books thinner; slippage large.

interactions.hypothesis: Winner and total legs interact via scoring script: a favorite winning correlates with the over only when its offense drives the margin, not when it wins through defense.
QB yardage and team total legs are positively correlated via pass volume, but negatively correlated with the favorite covering in garbage time.
Per-leg wording interacts with fees: voided legs change the effective payout and combo pricing, so compare executable price after fees to joint probability.

qb_passing_yards.label: QB passing yards ladder
qb_passing_yards.target: Probability a quarterback's official regulation-and-overtime passing yards exceed each rung (e.g. 199.5 to 349.5), or exceed another QB (H2H).
qb_passing_yards.mechanism: Passing yards = dropbacks x (1 - sack rate) x attempt share x completion rate x yards per completion. Volume comes from expected plays (pace), neutral pass rate (PROE) and game script from the spread; efficiency from opponent-adjusted EPA per dropback, air yards and CPOE, and is modified by pressure faced (OL versus pass rush, time to throw), coverage shell and target distribution, receiver and OL availability, weather and roof. The distribution is right-skewed, with garbage-time and overtime volume in the tail and injury exit in the left tail.

qb_passing_tds_and_ints.label: QB passing TD and interception counts
qb_passing_tds_and_ints.target: Probability a QB throws at least N touchdown passes, or at least N interceptions (or both), in the game as officially scored.
qb_passing_tds_and_ints.mechanism: Passing TDs = red-zone and goal-line pass trips x conversion; team scoring expectation and the run/pass split near the goal line determine opportunities, and passing TD luck regresses strongly. Interceptions = attempts x INT rate, where INT rate mixes QB turnover-worthy throw rate, pressure, aggressiveness, throw depth and defender luck. rushing_yards.target: Probability a player's rushing yards (or attempts) exceed a threshold, or exceed another player.
rushing_yards.mechanism: Rushing yards = rush attempts x yards per attempt. Variance is high because a few long runs dominate.

game_total.label: Game total points and both-teams-score
game_total.target: Probability that total points exceed a rung (with or without OT per wording) or that both teams score at least N points.
game_total.mechanism: Total = home points + away points = sum over possessions of points per possession. Model plays per game from the pace of both offenses and defenses (and clock use from run rate), drives from turnover and punt rates, and points per drive from opponent-adjusted EPA, explosiveness, red-zone conversion, field position and kicker; then apply weather and venue adjustments, and mix over uncertainty in lineups. Totals have fat tails (blowouts, defensive TDs) and key-number mass (e.g., 41, 44, 47), and both-teams-score requires each team to exceed its threshold with correlated outcomes.
